patch.value: Add pm brief duplicates post-merge near-duplicate sweep

Register a 'brief duplicates' subcommand that sweeps the merged tracker for near-duplicate items the create-time advisory cannot see across agent branches, using the shared SDK findSimilarItems primitive. Collapses A~B/B~A into unordered pairs, ranks by score, and emits advisory remediation commands.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Real-data proof on throwaway workspace /tmp/dup-proof: created pm-plbh 'Fix flaky auth test' (agent-a), pm-p800 'flaky auth test fails intermittently' (agent-b), pm-yuvi 'Refactor the report renderer' (agent-c, unrelated). At default threshold 0.6: 'No likely duplicate items found (threshold 0.6, scanned 3).' exit 0. At threshold 0.3: found 1 pair pm-p800|pm-plbh score 0.5 title_token_jaccard with remediation 'pm update pm-p800 --dep id=pm-plbh,kind=related'. Unrelated pm-yuvi NOT reported (no false positive). JSON output is a bare object with pairs/count/threshold/scanned keys.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Also ran against this repo's own .agents/pm tracker (29 items): pm brief duplicates --threshold 0.3 found 5 likely duplicate pairs (all title_token_jaccard, scores 0.364/0.333/0.308/0.3/0.3), all both-closed so remediation relates newer to older. npm test: 115 pass / 0 fail (96 pre-existing + 19 new). npm run typecheck clean. Bumped @unbrained/pm-cli to ^2026.7.25 in deps+devDeps and ran npm install --package-lock-only. Used SDK findSimilarItems for all scoring; no custom similarity/tokenizer.
